correctness.rationale: The actual RESULT.md proves the all-k equality by inradius-one normalization: ||z||_N<=||z||_2, ||x||_2<=R=sec(pi/N), and ||x+y||_2^2+||x-y||_2^2<=4R^2. Both norms cannot exceed sqrt(2)R in their minimum. For N=8k+4 the pi/4 and 3pi/4 circumvertices form a quarter-turn pair; sums/differences are on coordinate facet-normal rays and each has norm sqrt(2)R. N=4 gives 2, N=12 gives 2(sqrt(3)-1). No interpolation from sampled N is used. Script verifies only finite indices. Critical hypotheses: real dimension two, exact regular polygon, k>=0.
